CustomField.description: Auto-managed. Do not set on insert — the system silently overrides to Recurring, producing the misleading error "You can only create a custom schedule when the commitment schedule type is Custom" when a Custom GiftCommitmentSchedule is then attached. Correct pattern: insert GiftCommitment with no ScheduleType, then insert one or more GiftCommitmentSchedule children; ScheduleType is populated from the first schedule. Note: ScheduleType populates at insert time (indicates the shape of the schedule that was attached); the sibling CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId only populates when that schedule's StartDate arrives (indicates the schedule is currently in force). A commitment can have ScheduleType set while CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId is still null — this is a future-dated schedule waiting to activate. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md. Allowed values: Recurring, Custom.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when a gift commitment schedule is created. Recurring = a regular cadence; Custom = a manually defined payment schedule. Populates at insert time regardless of the schedule's Start Date. To check if a schedule is currently active, use the Current Gift Commitment Schedule lookup instead.
